handoff.objective: Tell me how long each stage of an engineering job took, measured from the job's own recorded transitions, so I can see where the work actually waits.
handoff.result: Added StageTiming dataclass and EngineeringJob.stage_timings() method that derives how long a job spent in each state from its own recorded transitions. Each visit to a state gets one timing entry with entered_on, exited_on and days; the current (open) state has exited_on=None and days=0. Five tests cover the full loop, fresh jobs, day arithmetic, open intervals and serialization.
risks: StageTiming measures calendar days (dt.date granularity) because that is what transitions record; sub-day precision is not available from the job's own data.
